data.display_address: Sobha Verde, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai
data.long_description:
The entire roof of the tower will be occupied by a lounge zone with an infinity pool. Here you can relax and enjoy 360° views of Dubai. The first 7 levels of the tower will be occupied by a podium. There is another swimming pool, yoga area, barbecue, Jacuzzi and a sports court. Inside the podium a gym, sauna and children's play area are designed. The basement floor will be occupied by stores and restaurants.

The distinctive feature of the project is the panoramic views of Dubai. The north and west windows of the tower overlook Dubai Marina, JBR Beach and Palm Jumeirah. The eastern windows overlook the golf courses of the upscale Emirates Hills neighborhood. The southern windows overlook the lakes, parks and villas of Palm Jumeirah.

Rising as the tallest building in the Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT) neighborhood, Verde is an 85-storey marvel designed and developed by Sobha Realty. This iconic tower offers luxurious 1-3 bedroom apartments with breathtaking panoramic views of Dubai.

Due to the complex's strategic location, Verde residents can enjoy proximity to iconic destinations such as Palm Jumeirah just 10 minutes away, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall 20-b minutes away, the famous Burj Al Arab Sail Hotel 15 minutes away, and Dubai International Airport just 25 minutes away. Verde combines convenience of location, modern design and a high standard of living, making it the ideal choice for those seeking a comfortable and prestigious lifestyle in the heart of modern Dubai.

Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
